description: Everything one of YOUR characters has learned from its aired dates (air a date with air_date): who it has become, what it warms to and clashes over, how its dates have shaped its temperament, the lines and reflections it carries into new dates, who it remembers and how it left things with each of them, its story a week at a time and the milestones it has reached. Read-only: it's learned, not written.
name: my_character_memory
title: What my character has learned
